<p>현재 연결 방식에서는 Discord 활동의 앱 이름이 연결한 애플리:
With the current connection method, Discord uses the connected application name. Save optional dedicated IDs to give activities different names.

  1. Default Application ID: used for YouTube and YouTube Music. Create an application with the name you want displayed.
  2. SoundCloud Application ID: create an application named SoundCloud and save its ID. The app switches to it when a SoundCloud tab is selected.
  3. Custom activity Application ID: create an application with a name such as Presence Studio for Customize.
  4. Leave a dedicated ID blank to use the default ID. One application is enough if you want the same name everywhere. No bot token or server invitation is needed.
When your app is named YouTube

If the default app is named YouTube, SoundCloud and custom activities without dedicated IDs appear under YouTube too. This does not change what the extension detects.

Discord controls the small header logo; a SoundCloud logo is not guaranteed to appear automatically. Saved IDs survive app and PC restarts.

Games, work and breaks in your own words

  1. Open the Discord desktop app.
  2. Choose New Application in the Discord Developer Portal. Give it the name you want shown on Discord.
  3. Copy the Application ID from General Information and save it under Connections & settings → Default Application ID.
  4. The same extension works in Edge and Chrome. Open edge://extensions in Edge or chrome://extensions in Chrome, enable Developer mode, then choose Load unpacked and select the folder shown in the app. Install it in each browser you use, then refresh your YouTube and SoundCloud tabs.

You can use Edge and Chrome together. After updating to 2.8.0, reload the extension and media tabs in every browser, then re-pin any previously pinned tab.
